messages.subject: INLA incompatible with CentOS 7.6
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to use INLA on a server that uses CentOS 7.6 as OS. 
I am getting this error, when using inla.qsample

Error in file(rng.file, "rb") : cannot open the connection

It seems that INLA is incompatible with this OS. 

Any solution?
